title: The "what are we?" talk: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Ever started the "what are we" talk and swerved into pizza?
One calm question, zero panic. Asking is allowed.

title: Says sorry without a "but"
old_caption: Door 1 and Aries already swatted the "but" right out of the room. An apology with no fine print hits different. Who taught you to say sorry and stop there?

title: Asks how the big thing went
old_caption: Taurus put your interview on the fridge and texted the minute you walked out. Remembering the date is cute. Asking how it went is the flag. Who always checks in after your big day?

title: Kind to the server
old_caption: Wrong drink, zero drama, a big thank you. Capricorn's checklist didn't stand a chance. How someone treats the server tells you plenty. Which sign is the nicest regular at your café?

title: Packs a spare pair of gloves
old_caption: Sagittarius left the house without gloves, as one does. Cancer packed two pairs, as one does. Tag the person who always has a spare.

title: Lets you finish your story
old_caption: Leo had a thought, swallowed it, and asked what happened next. That's growth. Also, the goose had a scarf. Who in your life lets you get to the good part?

title: Hears "no" the first time
old_caption: "Not tonight." "Ok! Rest up." No sulking, no second ask, no guilt trip. Scorpio was ready for a negotiation that never came. What's the smallest no you wish people heard?

title: Puts the phone face down at dinner
old_caption: The phone buzzed. Libra flipped it over without looking and kept listening to Gemini's snow speech. Small move, huge energy. Phone on the table or in the bag at dinner?

title: Says "take your time"
old_caption: Forty pages of menu, one Taurus, and a Scorpio who never once sighed. Patience is a whole personality. Be honest: are you the menu reader or the one waiting?

title: Celebrates your small wins
old_caption: One new leaf on a houseplant and Sagittarius threw a full parade. Get you someone who brings a banner to your tiny wins. What small win deserves confetti this week?
